name: Lubba
_why_scale: Size pass (Nick): 1.15x Mario's in-game height (model height x the Boo sizescale row x scale; Mario = 1.0, stock max DK 1.62). Was 1 (0.84x).
_why_hitting_ability: Nick: Star Get is a hitting ability (the batter star when they come up to bat, batter_star.py): the star swing row with the bat icon (star_move_labels.py). Their item row is Star Bit Storm.

bat._why: Boo's bat tinted Lubba purple, grin blue: python scripts/make_bat.py models/work/bats/lubba.bin 32 --hue 0 280 40 --tint 0.72 0.48 0.95

_why_balance: git-8a's balance pass (Nick): own stats; chemistry starts neutral (not the template's). Galaxy 2 captain of Starship Mario with Mario; leads the Lumas.
_why_strike_zone: python scripts/strike_zones.py --write: Boo's zone sits 53% of the way up its body in the batting stance (0.950 on 0.33..1.51); this body is 0.16..1.79, so 1.021 (the template's 0.950 would sit at 48%). World height = this x sizescale x scale
